[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The script detailed the bank heist scene with the Joker and his crew wearing clown masks, taking hostages, and the Joker's dialogue: "Ladies and gentlemen, today's your lucky day! We're here for your money, not your lives... unless, of course, you try to be a hero."  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The script described the Joker using a small explosive device to blow the vault door open and gathering money into duffel bags.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lt. Vincent Hanna was depicted as a seasoned detective parked outside the bank, requesting backup.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The script included a high-speed chase with the Joker leaning out the window and firing shots at pursuing police cars.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Joker's dialogue included: "Time to go, boys. We've got a city to paint with chaos."

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The new ending included the Joker's dialogue: "You see, it's not just about the money. It's about sending a message. And today, we sent a message loud and clear. Chaos is inevitable, and I am its harbinger."  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The robbers transferred their bags into a nondescript white van and used a smoke bomb to create a smokescreen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lt. Hanna was depicted as frustrated, stating: "The suspects have switched vehicles. I've lost visual. Notify all units to be on the lookout for a white van."
